verdict.rationale: The docs say `@coderabbitai review` performs an incremental review of only new changes, and the auto-review settings imply reviews fire on new commits (they can 'pause after a set number of commits'). Fix tracking is only implied, by the request-changes workflow staying 'synchronized with resolved feedback' and by comment-resolution commands. missing for 10: explicit documentation that each push automatically triggers an incremental re-review, evidence that prior comments are auto-resolved or marked fixed rather than repeated, independent or hands-on corroboration.
